title: F_5 HIP device kernel
description:
Implement the F_5 HIP device kernel mirroring T23's structure, using the F_5 packed encoding chosen by R1.

## Background

Same shape as the F_3 device kernel (T23): batched matrix-permanent on gfx1030, one matrix per block, wavefront-wide reductions. The F_5 ops use the bitwise formulas from R1's chosen encoding (`6917eb85`).

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] `crates/gf2-kernels-hip/hip/permanent/permanent_bipedal5.hip` exists with the device kernel.
- [ ] [hard] On gfx1030, kernel output bit-identical to CPU `permanent_bipedal5` on 100 random matrices for $n \in \{8, 12\}$ (bounded by `Packed5::LANES`).
- [ ] [hard] Tests gated `#[cfg(feature = "hip")]` and `#[ignore = "external: gfx1030 device required"]`.
- [ ] [hard] `cargo build -p gf2-kernels-hip --release --features hip` succeeds.
